name: fl-design-system
description: Fission's own design system, end to end: fl-ds-setup scaffolds a brand-new project on it or installs/updates its branded shadcn components into an existing one, and ten component skills (fl-ds-button, fl-ds-input, fl-ds-card, fl-ds-dialog, fl-ds-table, fl-ds-form, fl-ds-badge, fl-ds-select, fl-ds-tabs, fl-ds-toast) each check it's installed before using it, installing it on the spot if not. Scoped deliberately to Fission's own system only — no generic multi-brand detection.
_schema_note: Verified against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference (checked 2026-10-09). No 'skills' array: the standard skills/ directory scan already covers all 11 skills here, and an explicit array only adds to that scan, so it would be a redundant hand-maintained duplicate.
